preregistration_commit: see docs/AGENT_CONTEXT.md MODEL_B_PREREG_COMMIT (recorded at commit time)

frozen_scientific_contract.lora: r=16 alpha=32 dropout=0.05 bias=none; targets q/k/v/o_proj (8), gate/up/down_proj (32), in_proj_qkv/out_proj (24)
frozen_scientific_contract.interaction: one readout; h_t/h_e = last-decoder-layer content-token mean-pool; u=W_u h_t, v=W_v h_e (4096->256); s=cosine(u,v) [score change: dot product replaced by cosine BEFORE freeze]; e=concat(u,v) in R^512
frozen_scientific_contract.heads: exactly two: K-way raw-logit classification head (K=6) + correspondence score (L_CORR only); no EDL head, no novelty head
frozen_scientific_contract.objective: L = L_CE + L_CORR, lambda_corr=1.0; L_CORR=softplus(-(s_real - s_matched_shuffled)); no margin/temperature/contrastive
frozen_scientific_contract.matched_shuffled: MATCHED_SHUFFLED_TRAIN: Known TRAIN only, same class, same availability state, different activity group, different row, no bit-identical serialization; one deterministic negative per positive; COARSE_BUCKET_MATCHING=OMIT; Unknown never a negative
frozen_scientific_contract.eval_shuffled: UNRESTRICTED_SHUFFLED_EVAL: evaluation-only, distinct name in code/artifacts/reports
frozen_scientific_contract.training: full rotation Known-TRAIN population (Credential 27009 / Recon_Scanning 28031 / Web_Injection 27357), 2 fixed epochs, batch 2 + accum 4, AdamW lr=1e-4 wd=0.01 warmup 100, bf16, grad checkpointing, seed 20260817+100*r_index, fixed terminal epoch, no early stopping, no Unknown-based selection
frozen_scientific_contract.fits: 3 rotations x {QWEN_CE_ONLY, QWEN_CE_PLUS_CORR} = 6 Qwen fits + 3 non-Qwen baseline fits
frozen_scientific_contract.retention_gate: MODEL_B_RET_B >= 0.50 AND MODEL_B_RET_S >= 0.50 (median over S(A,RAW)); >=2/3 rotations on both comparisons, no reversed rotation; STOP_NEEDS_REVIEW if threshold mathematically inappropriate
frozen_scientific_contract.transfer_gate: pooled REAL-over-BASIC AUROC increment (secondary REAL-over-UNRESTRICTED_SHUFFLED_EVAL), point >= +0.02 AND CI lower > 0, >=2/3 families material on both, rotation consistency >=2/3 no reversed; Unknown eval-only
frozen_scientific_contract.baseline_d: 6-layer transformer encoder hidden 512 8 heads GELU, char-level frozen tokenizer, same text contract, e in R^256, same two heads/objective/recipe, ~19M params, no search

hard_boundaries: no modification of prior gate results
